resources.string: Link your MetaTrader account and signals open on it.
This section is open to accounts holding a subscription.
On — new signals will open on your account.
Off — nothing opens on your account.
Turning this on takes only signals from this moment forward; positions already open will not be entered on your account.
The terms the copy runs under

Enter your MetaTrader 5 account details — the same ones you sign into the terminal with.

This password is sent to the server so the terminal can sign into your account. An Investor password is not enough — it has to be the trading account\'s own password, so enter it with the care a real password deserves.
